existing.description: The FWF ASTRA Awards are a career funding programme launched in July 2024 for advanced postdocs in Austria who already have experience with independent research (R3 level). The FWF awards between EUR 500,000 and EUR 1 million per project over five years, plus an additional EUR 200,000 tenure package for female principal investigators who secure a permanent position within the first three years. The programme is decided by the FWF Scientific Board on the recommendation of an international jury following peer review and a hearing, with about 18 awards per call and half of them awarded to women. Proposals are submitted through the elane portal during a published annual application window, which was closed on the verification date.
eligibility: Academic qualifications needed to lead the proposed research project
Doctoral degree awarded at least 2 and not more than 9 years prior to September 30 of the year of submission (exceptions such as parental leave are defined in the Application Guidelines)
In arts-based research, researchers without a doctorate may apply with at least 2 to a maximum of 9 years of relevant experience according to international standards
Not already holding a tenured professorship or an equivalent permanent leadership position, and not already having accepted such an appointment
Researchers may apply to the ASTRA programme a maximum of two times in their career and may serve as principal investigator in only one approved project
All Austrian research institutions are eligible to apply; the project must be carried out in Austria
existing.eligibility_summary: Successful, internationally visible researchers from all disciplines, including arts-based research, who already have experience of independent research (R3 level) and whose doctorate was awarded at least 2 and not more than 9 years before 30 September of the year of submission.
benefits: Project funding of EUR 500,000 to a maximum of EUR 1 million for five years
Additional EUR 200,000 tenure package for female principal investigators
Fallback funding as a three-year Principal Investigator Project (Merit Award) of up to EUR 450,000 for shortlisted applicants who do not win an ASTRA Award
coverage: Project-specific costs of EUR 500,000 to a maximum of EUR 1 million over five years
An additional EUR 200,000 tenure package for female principal investigators who are granted a permanent position within the first three years
requirements: Applications are submitted online via the elane digital application portal
Funding is administered in PROFI mode, so the application must be approved for submission by both the applicant and the Austrian host research institution
All forms must be completed online and all documents uploaded in full before institutional approval
The FWF strongly recommends limiting the number of ASTRA applications per research institution, per the Guidelines on the Maximum Number of ASTRA Applications
Half of the ASTRA Awards are granted to women
documents: Alternative project plan (max. 2 pages including cost breakdown) for the Merit Award fallback
Template publication record of the principal investigator
Scientific disciplines / Code Statistics Austria classification document
Information on and checklist/form for accounting for career breaks, if applicable
Evidence of positive ethics commission opinion for clinical research projects, if applicable
existing.english_requirement: The official programme page and ASTRA application guidelines are published in English; no English language test for applicants is stated
application_method: Online application through the elane digital application portal during the published application window
existing.selection_notes: Decision by the Scientific Board based on a recommendation by an international jury; recommendations are made on the basis of international peer review and a hearing. Projects presented at the hearing that do not receive an ASTRA Award will be funded as three-year Principal Investigator Projects with a maximum of EUR 450,000 each (Merit Awards).
existing.best_fit: Internationally visible researchers 2 to 9 years after their doctorate, from any discipline including arts-based research, who are building a case for an academic leadership position and have not yet taken up a permanent professorship.
existing.notes: The formal announcement of the FWF ASTRA Awards takes place each June. Approximately 18 award winners are expected per call, depending on the FWF funding budget. A 2026 award round has already taken place, with 18 grants presented for five-year projects at universities and research institutions across Austria.
existing.application_period: Annual call with a fixed submission window; the 2026 call has closed and the next window was not yet published on 2026-10-04
existing.deadline_display: Submissions are accepted only during a published annual application window; on 2026-10-04 the official page showed "Currently no submissions". The next call window is not yet published.
existing.program_type: Career award for advanced postdocs (principal investigator project)
